course: Week One - Quantum Sales Bootcamp (Revenue Efficiency Model)
title: The Quantum Revenue Efficiency Model: Keep, Grow, Multiply, Convert, Expand
description:
The fastest revenue is usually the revenue closest to you. Shawn Peterson introduces the Quantum Revenue Efficiency Model, five places to find revenue in order: keep the customers you have, grow within them, multiply through referrals and partners, convert what is already in your funnel, then expand to new cold prospects.

This is part 1 of 15 in the Quantum Revenue Efficiency Model series from Quantum Academy.

See the model: https://www.thequantumleap.business/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=rev-efficiency-model#revenue-efficiency-model
Book time with Shawn: https://meetings.hubspot.com/shawn-peterson

Shawn Peterson is CEO of Quantum Business Solutions, a HubSpot Platinum Solutions Partner that helps B2B sales teams systemize, optimize and automate revenue growth. https://www.thequantumleap.business
